title: 128. God's Mercy - Renounce Even Oneself for the Sake of Salvation!

reels.title: Did the grumbling of parents drive children out into the wide world?
reels.hook: Why did your children leave for Germany?
reels.why: The claim about the emigration of young people is provocative and touches upon a painful topic for many families. It starts with a strong statement and ends with a personal point about loneliness in old age.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: The majority of young people from Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina left because of the grumbling of parents.

cards.text: Why did your children leave for Germany?
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
The host interprets Paul's message to the Philippians to do everything "without grumbling".
Germany, Austria, the wide world
The majority of young people from Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina left because of the grumbling of parents.
God's Mercy – Renounce Even Oneself for the Sake of Salvation!

reels.title: "I was in hell in spirit": an experience that changed him
reels.hook: He says that God showed him hell
reels.why: A personal, powerful testimony with a clear image and emotion. Along with a concrete source (the 5th exercise of St. Ignatius, Manresa), the story has a beginning and an end.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: I was in hell in spirit. Saw what it looks like. That is terrible.

cards.text: He says that God showed him hell
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
The Spiritual Exercises of St. Ignatius contain a meditation on sin and hell.
Fifth exercise: meditation on hell
I was in hell in spirit. Saw what it looks like. That is terrible.
Manresa, Spain

reels.title: Three people in 150 square meters? "Then something is not right"
reels.hook: You live in 150 square meters with one child?
reels.why: Concrete figures and direct, challenging advice on housing and property. Easy to recognize oneself and comment.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: Renounce of property everything you do not need.

cards.text: You live in 150 square meters with one child?
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
Interpretation of Lk 14: whoever does not renounce everything he possesses cannot be a disciple.

reels.title: What does "to hate father and mother" from the Gospel mean?
reels.hook: Why does Jesus ask that you "hate" parents?
reels.why: Resolves a confusing sentence from the Gospel that many do not understand. A clear insight rounded off in a single thought.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: Meaning, it is completely irrelevant what your mom and dad tell you about your faith.

cards.text: Why does Jesus ask that you "hate" parents?
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
The Gospel according to Luke 14:25-33: Jesus addresses the multitude following him.
Meaning, it is completely irrelevant what your mom and dad tell you about your faith.

reels.title: "Give children circumstances of poverty": advice on upbringing
reels.hook: The best upbringing? A little poverty
reels.why: A short and counterintuitive claim about upbringing encourages discussion. The thought is rounded off in less than a minute.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: Give them circumstances of poverty, and you will do the best for their upbringing.

cards.text: The best upbringing? A little poverty
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
The host interprets Jesus' call to renounce property.

reels.title: "One shouldn't fear God"? The host responds from the Bible
reels.hook: Should one fear God at all?
reels.why: A polemical response to a common objection, expressed sharply and with humor ("empty head"). It is short and ends with a clear stance.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: Then you won't curse or sin when you fear God.

cards.text: Should one fear God at all?
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
Interprets Paul's call to the Philippians to work "with fear and trembling".
Then you won't curse or sin when you fear God.

reels.title: At the age of 47: "a visa for heaven or a visa for hell"
reels.hook: Before him is a visa for heaven or for hell
reels.why: A personal and concrete confession (47th year of life, third phase of life) with a striking image of a visa. Ends with criticism of preaching "with kid gloves".
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: That is a visa for heaven or a visa for hell.
